scope: Independent deterministic local bounded GET lease and hook review. No browser, network, full application build, source edits, frozen-packet edits, push, or production changes.
limits: Only bounded GET and subsequent identified same-chain authority are wall-clock-independent. Unbound SSE retains the prior bounded-wall-skew experiment.

Deterministic in-memory and jsdom tests establish policy and hook behavior, not browser screenshots, paint timing, production atomicity, Redis implementation, throughput, capacity suitability, or rollout safety.

A blocked JavaScript thread cannot update already-painted pixels. Timer-stall assertions establish refusal on response processing and on the next render, not a wall-clock deadline for pixels while JavaScript is suspended.
Server lease identity stability and trustworthy remaining budget are protocol prerequisites. This suite tests consumer behavior; no network or independent server implementation audit was performed.
